Hi all — thanks for the ping. Below are concise answers you can share with Amaya; happy to join a call if useful.

1) Primary data deletion SLA:
- Standard: When a customer requests deletion or terminates service, Redwood deletes customer primary data from our active storage within 30 calendar days. Deletion includes model inputs/outputs and associated metadata stored in primary tier.

2) Backups and snapshot retention:
- Default backup retention: 90 days (rolling snapshots). Backups are encrypted at rest.
- Deletion from backups: Backups are immutable snapshots; we do not perform selective purging of individual customer data from historical snapshots on a sub-24h schedule. Instead, customer data is removed from backups as backups age out on the 90-day retention window. For regulated customers requiring faster removal, we offer contractually negotiable shorter backup retention windows and can implement targeted key-revocation/crypto-erase processes when feasible.

3) Logs retention:
- Default: operational and request logs retained for 365 days.
- Configurable: customers can request shorter retention windows (e.g., 90/180 days) as part of contract terms for an enterprise deployment. Longer retention is available as an add-on.

4) GDPR / Right-to-be-forgotten (RTBF):
- We support RTBF. Process: upon validated request, we remove data from active storage within 30 days and initiate retention policy steps for backups (see above). We provide a deletion confirmation and timeline. For backups, the effective purging will align with the backup retention window unless a negotiated contractual process (e.g., crypto-erase) is in place.

5) SOC 2 scope and attestation: 
- We maintain SOC 2 Type II attestation covering infrastructure, change management, access controls, encryption, and backup procedures (most recent attestation attached). Requests for the full report are handled under NDA; we can provide the report and a short SOC2 summary doc.

6) DPA / Data processing terms:
- We have a standard DPA available; we can share a DocuSign link or incorporate your procurement language.

Attachments: Data_Retention_Policy_Summary.pdf (details and timelines), SOC2_TypeII_Attestation.pdf
